title: Rory and the Silver Shore
verses:
As the silver moon rose over sleepy green hills,
And Psittaco chirped from a leaf on a tree,
The valley grew quiet with cool soothing rills,
As Rory led friends to the shore of the sea.

High up in the sky, little Nia soared slow,
To search for a hollow where coziness grew.
She saw a soft glade in the silvery glow,
All covered in moss that was dusted with dew.

Big Benny stepped in with a heavy soft thud,
And Tilly swept leaves in a circle so neat.
They cleared off the stones and the slippery mud,
To make a warm bed for their weary tired feet.

Brave Ricky lay down with his chin on his paw,
His shiny green armor was cozy and bright.
Tiny Psittaco nested with feelings of awe,
Tucked into a wing for a rest through the night.

Soft Rory breathed in with a deep sleepy sigh,
And tucked his small arms to his gentle green chest.
As stars started blinking high up in the sky,
He knew all his friends were now safe and at rest.

The silvery night wraps the hollow in peace,
The breezes sing softly a lullaby song.
The sounds of the day will now soften and cease,
To drift in a dreamland so warm and so long.
